title: First Repeated Letter
statement: Given a string word, return the first letter that appears twice. Ignore case. If no letter repeats, return null.
think: What is the task asking? Find the first character that is seen for the second time.
What is the key operation? Quickly check whether a character was already seen.
What wording signals stand out? First repeated, duplicate, seen before.
What is the brute force idea? For each letter, scan previous characters.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a HashSet while scanning left to right.
What are the edge cases? Mixed case, no duplicates, spaces.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(k) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I scan the string and return as soon as adding to the set fails.
algorithm: Iterate through the string in lower case
If current letter is already in seen, return it
If no repeat is found, return null
interview: I would use a HashSet because this problem is about detecting whether a letter was seen before. I scan left to right and return the first letter whose insertion fails.
ru: Это классическая задача seen before -> HashSet. Как только буква встречается второй раз, сразу возвращаем её.
visualExplanation:
word = "programming"
p -> add
r -> add
o -> add

r -> already seen -> answer = 'r'

critical: Use Dictionary when only seen/not seen is required
nice: Do not explain why HashSet is enough without counts

gaps: Important: distinguish seen-before problems from frequency problems
Nice to have: explain why scanning order matters
constraints: Assume the input is a short word or phrase.
whyThisPattern: This is a HashSet problem because we only need to know whether a character was already seen.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because we do not need counts to find the first repeated letter.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no left/right comparison.
